anti_patterns_discovered.pattern: Stale planning docs manufacturing phantom bugs
anti_patterns_discovered.manifestation: CLAUDE.md footgun #3 cited src/audio_out/sine_synth.rs:192 which was deleted in bb6c691. CONCERNS.md cited src/generator/, src/audio/inference.rs, src/humanize/ — all deleted. .planning/.continue-here.md cited #81 slice 3 as pending — already shipped. STATE.md frontmatter 3 update-cycles stale. Result: 10 of 21 brutal-critic audit items returned 'PHANTOM' verdicts after agents wasted time investigating non-existent code.
anti_patterns_discovered.prevention_mechanism: Update planning docs immediately after major refactors. Specifically: when src/X is moved to crates/Y, grep all .planning/**/*.md for src/X references and update or delete. Done partially in 279a613 but CONCERNS.md and STRUCTURE.md still cite deleted code — ~70% of CONCERNS.md is dead per critic #18.

anti_patterns_discovered.manifestation: Brutal-critic agents downstream cite stale docs as evidence, producing 'CONFIRMED REAL BUG' reports that are actually doc-rot artifacts. Three separate critics reported phantom bugs traceable to the same stale CLAUDE.md footgun.
anti_patterns_discovered.prevention_mechanism: Brutal-critic prompts should be instructed to verify file existence (Read or Grep) before treating an audit claim as real. Or run a doc-freshness audit before any brutal-critic dispatch.

anti_patterns_discovered.manifestation: PluginAdapter had noteUpdates: false even after plugin emitted noteUpdates correctly — capability flag and implementation drift in opposite directions. Caught and fixed but worth structural mitigation.
anti_patterns_discovered.prevention_mechanism: When wiring a new feature, grep adapter capability files (ui/src/lib/adapter/*.ts) for related flags. Flip explicitly in the same commit.
